items.text: Does the company offer multiple GLP-1 RA molecules (e.g., semaglutide, liraglutide, tirzepatide) with different dosing forms?
Are the company's GLP-1 products available in both injectable and oral formulations?
Does the portfolio include combination therapies (e.g., GLP-1/GIP) or fixed-dose combinations?
Are the company's GLP-1 RAs approved for both type 2 diabetes and obesity indications?
Does the company's product show cardiovascular benefit claims (e.g., reduced MACE) in its label?
Does the company offer a once-weekly dosing option compared to daily competitors?
Does the company have active clinical trials for oral GLP-1 RAs or next-generation molecules?
Has the company published head-to-head trials against competitors (e.g., SURPASS, SUSTAIN)?
Is the company exploring novel indications like NASH, chronic kidney disease, or heart failure?
Does the company have multiple FDA-approved manufacturing sites for its GLP-1 products?
Has the company experienced any supply shortages or recalls in the past 2 years?
Does the company have capacity expansion plans to meet growing demand (e.g., new facilities)?
Are all GLP-1 products approved by major regulators (FDA, EMA, PMDA) without warning letters?
Does the company have a robust pharmacovigilance system for post-market safety monitoring?
Has the company received any FDA Form 483s or import alerts related to GLP-1 production?
Is the company's GLP-1 product available in at least 50 countries including the US and EU?
Does the company have reimbursement agreements with major payers (e.g., Medicare, NICE) for obesity?
Has the company launched in emerging markets like China, India, or Brazil?
Is the company's GLP-1 brand among the top 3 most prescribed in its class?
Does the company have strong presence at major medical congresses (ADA, EASD) with key data?
Are there any major safety controversies or lawsuits affecting brand perception?
Has the company's GLP-1 franchise revenue grown by at least 20% year-over-year?
Does the company have a market cap exceeding $100 billion, indicating financial stability?
Is the company's R&D spending on GLP-1 at least 15% of total revenue?
Does the company have a Phase 3 trial for an oral GLP-1 RA or combination therapy?
Is the company pursuing pediatric obesity or type 2 diabetes indications?
Are there plans to expand into cardiovascular or renal indications within 3 years?
Has the company formed strategic alliances for GLP-1 development or commercialization?
Does the company have licensing agreements to expand into new geographic markets?
Has the company acquired or partnered for novel delivery technologies (e.g., oral, patch)?
